distribution.narrative: Do not promote Taiwan to Present. The 2010 source explicitly states that Cryphalus taiwanus was described from timber imported to Japan from Taiwan and that actual occurrence in Taiwan needed confirmation.

host_note: Beaver & Liu (2010) reports Tsuga sp. as the host/substrate association. This genus-level host is retained as source-supported, but it does not resolve the uncertainty of Taiwan occurrence.
taxonomy_summary: The current accepted identity is Cryphalus taiwanus Schedl, 1970.

taxonomic_history.name: Cryphalus taiwanus
taxonomic_history.note: Current accepted name in the integrated taxonomic backbone.

nomenclature_note: The current accepted identity is Cryphalus taiwanus Schedl, 1970, VSN_1861. Beaver & Liu (2010) uses Cryphalus taiwanus with authorship Schedl.
